Interactive Unity experimentCase studyConnor Myers / Metater

Hypercone Visualizer

The visualizer pairs a static portfolio shell with a separately hosted Unity build, allowing the site to stay fast while the interactive experience remains directly accessible.

Open standalone demo
Technologies
  • Unity
  • WebGL
  • WebAssembly
  • Cloudflare
01 / Challenge

The problem

Present a large WebGL experiment without making a roughly 42 MB application part of the initial portfolio page load.

02 / Responsibility

What I owned

  • Unity visualization
  • WebGL publishing
  • Cross-origin asset hosting
  • Responsive embed lifecycle
03 / Decisions

Implementation choices

  • Keep the HTML shell in the website repository
  • Host versioned build binaries on assets.metater.net
  • Require explicit launch before iframe creation
  • Preserve the original public route
04 / Outcomes

What the structure enabled

  • The legacy URL remains functional on both hosting origins
  • The main portfolio transfers no Unity code before launch
  • The demo supports fullscreen and a separate-tab fallback
05 / Interactive

Explore the experiment.

The Unity runtime and build files remain completely unloaded until you choose to launch them.
